sources.title: DuplexCascade: Full-Duplex Speech-to-Speech Dialogue with VAD-Free Cascaded ASR-LLM-TTS Pipeline and Micro-Turn Optimization

direct_observations.architecture: Streaming cascaded ASR -> text LLM -> streaming TTS with VAD-free micro-turn interaction.
direct_observations.training_method: Text-only dynamically constructed duplex sequences; LoRA adaptation of Qwen2-7B-Instruct plus trainable token embeddings/head.
direct_observations.published_training_scale: 50k multi-turn text dialogues; 5k optimization steps; paper reports 8 H100 GPUs for 5 hours.
direct_observations.published_turn_control_result: Paper reports strongest averaged turn-taking accuracy among the evaluated open systems in its Full-Duplex-Bench table; this is upstream benchmark evidence only, not Frankenstein reproduction.
direct_observations.published_latency_tradeoff: Paper evaluates micro-turn durations 0.3-1.8 s and selects 0.6 s as a practical latency/accuracy trade-off despite best reported turn-taking accuracy near 1.2 s in its simulation setting.
direct_observations.released_speech_backend: Official README instructs Kyutai delayed-streams-modeling STT/TTS and starts STT with config-stt-en_fr-hf.toml.
german_blocking_evidence: Official Hugging Face model metadata declares language=en, not German.
Official released demo path names an English/French STT configuration, not German.
No primary-source German speech benchmark or German end-to-end dialogue result was found in the pinned paper/model/repository evidence.

bounded_inference.production_voice: DuplexCascade itself receives no German production-voice promotion because the released evidence does not establish German ASR/TTS/end-to-end support.
bounded_inference.architecture_transfer: The VAD-free micro-turn control policy is unusually compatible with Frankenstein's existing VoiceIntent/GWT arbitration because its special tokens correspond closely to WAIT, RESPOND, INTERRUPT/CANCEL and BACKCHANNEL decisions while leaving ASR, LLM and TTS modular. This is an engineering inference, not reproduced behavior.
bounded_inference.preferred_transfer_experiment: Do not port the 7B released model first. After the runner gate is restored, compare a bounded controller-only adaptation: feed the accepted German streaming ASR partials into a local text model at a fixed micro-turn cadence and map explicit control outputs into Frankenstein VoiceIntent/GWT, using the already selected German ASR/TTS components. Preserve current VAD as a safety/observation signal during the experiment rather than deleting it upfront.
bounded_inference.safety_boundary: WAIT/RESPOND/BACKCHANNEL tokens remain candidate control outputs and cannot bypass canonical state, tool/effect authority, cancellation accounting or VoiceOutcome re-entry.

falsifiers_remaining: A newer official DuplexCascade German checkpoint or German ASR/TTS configuration may exist outside the pinned sources and would reopen language eligibility.
On Frankenstein room audio, fixed micro-turn polling may create more ASR partial-instability and false interruption than the current VAD/endpoint path.
A local 0.8B-4B dialogue model may be too weak to learn semantic turn control without degrading answer/tool quality.
The extra periodic LLM evaluations may increase CPU/GPU contention enough to erase latency gains.
Retaining VAD as a safety signal may interact with the VAD-free learned policy and requires an explicit arbitration rule.
recommended_next_discriminator: After one eligible clay-direct-dev runner is restored and the existing queued Qwen3-ASR benchmark is consumed, benchmark a Frankenstein-native micro-turn controller as a separate bounded experiment: accepted German ASR partials -> fixed 0.6 s micro-turns -> explicit WAIT/RESPOND/INTERRUPT/BACKCHANNEL candidate -> current VoiceIntent/GWT arbitration; measure premature takeover, interruption-stop latency, backchannel precision, ASR-partial correction sensitivity, TTFT and resource contention. Do not require DuplexCascade's English Qwen2-7B checkpoint for this architecture test.
